title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Title: Senior Project Manager
Location: Richmond, VA (Hybrid
Duration: 6+ months
Notes:
Web Cam Interview Only
Professional Summary
  • Senior Project Manager with extensive experience leading large-scale, high-risk, complex enterprise implementations.
  • Proven expertise in Revenue Lifecycle/Healthcare system implementations or replacements.
  • Experienced managing multiple workstreams, cross-functional teams, vendors, consultants, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong background in budget management, risk mitigation, project governance, procurement, and enterprise project delivery.
  • Hands-on leader comfortable driving day-to-day project execution.
Key Experience to Highlight
  • Led enterprise system implementation/replacement projects from initiation through production.
  • Managed multiple concurrent workstreams with cross-functional business and IT teams.
  • Coordinated third-party vendors, consultants, implementation partners, and internal technical teams.
  • Managed project budgets, schedules, resource allocation, scope, deliverables, and expenditures.
  • Developed and maintained project plans, RAID logs, status reports, and executive dashboards.
  • Presented project updates, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and steering committees.
  • Identified, tracked, and mitigated project risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests.
  • Oversaw day-to-day project execution, ensuring milestones and deliverables were achieved.
  • Collaborated with solution architects, infrastructure teams, and technology leads to align project deliverables with enterprise standards.
  • Managed vendor performance using KPIs, SLAs, and defined success metrics.
  • Supported procurement activities, vendor selection, contract execution, and implementation planning.
  • Facilitated requirements gathering, project scoping, estimation, and planning across multiple workstreams.
  • Ensured compliance with project governance, PMO methodologies, and organizational standards.
  • Coordinated transition to operations, knowledge transfer, and project closure activities.
Preferred/Desired Keywords (Must Appear in Resume)
  • Revenue Lifecycle Management (RLM) / Revenue Cycle
  • Enterprise System Replacement
  • Healthcare IT
  • Vendor Management
  • Executive Stakeholder Management
  • PMO Governance
  • Budget Management
  • Risk Management
  • Resource Management
  • Procurement
  • Multiple Workstreams
  • Cross-functional Leadership
  • Schedule Management
  • Change Management
  • Requirements Gathering
  • Project Planning
  • Solution Architecture Collaboration
  • Third-party Vendor Coordination
  • Executive Presentations
  • Project Lifecycle Management
  • Agile
  • Waterfall
  • Hybrid Project Management
Certifications (if applicable)
  • PMP
  • PMI-ACP
  • Scrum Master (CSM/PSM)
  • ITIL
Most important: If the candidate has experience with Revenue Lifecycle/Revenue Cycle systems, healthcare/public sector, vendor management, executive presentations, multiple workstreams, or enterprise system replacement, make sure these are described with measurable accomplishments in the work experience section rather than only listed as skills. This JD emphasizes demonstrated experience over keyword matching.
Required skills:
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to lead others to implement new approaches, systems, structures, and methods.
  • Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) models.
  • Ability to understand technology at a level sufficient to represent the project team in multiple forums.
  • Strong experience leading business and IT resources through the discovery and documentation of business and technical requirements for Request for Solution Proposals (RFSPs).
  • Exceptional knowledge of both Agile and Waterfall project management principles and practices.
  • Active PMP certification from PMI.
  • Ability to run Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall project management methodologies.
  • Experience leading large programs with multiple workstreams.
  • Experience working with vendors and implementing vendor solutions.
  • Strong experience developing, executing, and managing cloud-hosted SaaS implementation projects.
  • Experience with Data Modernization and Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) initiatives.
  • Experience with VITA High Category Project Management.
  • Experience managing complex procurement initiatives involving RFI, RFP, and RFQ processes.
  • Experience managing projects to build, replace, and implement Financial Management Systems.

title: Peoplesoft Financial Functional Analyst
description:
Role: Peoplesoft Financial Functional Analyst
Location: Austin, TX (Remote)
Duration: 12+ Month
Type: Contract

Job Descriptions:
  • Serve as the functional subject matter expert (SME) for the Oracle PeopleSoft CAPPS Asset Management (AM) module.
  • Configure, maintain, and support Asset Management business units, asset profiles, depreciation rules, capitalization, and ChartField configurations.
  • Monitor and support daily production operations, batch jobs, and system integrations to ensure optimal performance and timely issue resolution.
  • Analyze business requirements and implement functional system enhancements, configuration changes, and process improvements.
  • Develop, review, and maintain Functional Design Documents (FDDs), business process documentation, and technical specifications.
  • Coordinate functional, regression, integration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for system enhancements and upgrades.
  • Support integrations between Asset Management, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Purchasing, and other CAPPS Financial modules.
  • Perform reconciliation activities between Asset Management and General Ledger while ensuring financial data accuracy and integrity.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, provide Tier 2 application support, and coordinate with Tier 3 managed service providers for issue resolution.
  • Monitor scheduled batch processes, validate job execution, manage dependencies, and resolve batch failures.
  • Utilize SQL, Application Designer, BI Publisher, SQR, and PeopleSoft tools to support reporting, analysis, and system configuration.
  • Support PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM), Change Assistant, data migration, Fluid UI enhancements, and patch implementation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with State of Texas security policies, NIST standards, ITIL best practices, and WCAG 2.1 accessibility requirements.
  • Participate in fiscal year-end processing, including planning, reconciliation, system configuration, verification, and reporting activities.
  • Coordinate disaster recovery testing, system upgrades, release management, and production deployments.
  • Participate in Major Incident Management (MIM) processes for Priority 1 and Priority 2 production incidents.
  • Prepare executive reports, audit documentation, compliance reports, and presentations for leadership and stakeholder meetings.
  • Collaborate with business users, policy teams, developers, vendors, and state agencies to gather requirements and deliver business solutions.
  • Provide end-user training, knowledge transfer, documentation, and mentoring to junior analysts and support staff.
  • Maintain ServiceNow, BOSSDesk, and other incident management systems with accurate documentation and timely status updates.
  • Ensure system security, data integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across CAPPS Financial applications.
  • Support statewide ERP initiatives, legislative changes, and enterprise-wide financial system enhancements.
  • Perform additional system analysis, configuration, testing, and project support activities as assigned.
Minimum Recruitments:
  • Extensive knowledge and understanding of State of Texas applicable policies.
  • Extensive technical skillsets needed with App Designer, Integration Broker, assorted SQR/SQL, BI Publisher, SAP Business Objects, etc. to support functional responsibilities.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience performing system configuration changes.
  • Experience working with the Asset Management (AM) core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Extensive knowledge supporting and providing oversight with batch jobs, i.e., Run My Jobs (RMJ)
  • Extensive knowledge of security best practices, NIST standards, and multi-tenancy applicability for a statewide ERP instance.
  • Extensive Texas public sector experience, directly working for or supporting a large network
  • (30 or more) of Texas state government agencies
  • Extensive experience creating and managing a strategic roadmap by combining strong planning skills, functional insight, and effective cross-functional communication
  • Extensive familiarity with support tools such as PUM, Fluid and Elastic Search
  • Experience performing functional project management activities in support of CPA's CAPPS program
  • Experience providing Tier 2 Service Desk Support for a large network (30 or more) of agencies with a Managed Services vendor providing Tier 3
  • Experience participating in Disaster Recovery exercises.
  • Experience preparing and presenting executive-level presentations
  • Experience gathering and presenting applicable data in support of a variety of audits and open records requests.
  • Extensive experience supporting the CAPPS Financials tower in PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience developing requirements, analyzing, designing, developing, testing, and implementing components of two or more of CPA's statewide systems: CAPPS, TINS, SPA, and USAS
  • Experience planning and coordinating the Fiscal Year Process at a statewide level
  • Experience supporting Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents in coordination with the Major Incident Management (MIM) process.
  • Experience in interpreting contractual language and integrating it into daily workflows, while consistently holding vendors accountable to contractual requirements
  • Experience preparing WCAG 2.1-compliant materials for distribution.
  • Experience working with the CAPPS Financials Purchasing module
  • Knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) principles and practices for IT activities such as IT service management (ITSM) and IT asset management (ITAM) that focus on aligning IT services with the needs of the business
  • Experience working with the Purchasing core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the General Ledger core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the Accounts Payable core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the Accounts Receivable/Billing non-core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the Inventory non-core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the Project Costing non-core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the Strategic Sourcing non-core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2
  • Experience working with the Travel & Expense non-core module of PeopleSoft FSCM version 9.2

title: Salesforce Support Analyst (Tier 1 / Application Support)
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Support Analyst (Tier 1 / Application Support)
Location: Denver, CO (Onsite)
Duration: 12+ Months
Note: Candidate must be local.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Provides Salesforce and Salesforce third-party application support to to internal and external users on CHATS technology issues and identifies, researches, and resolves technical problems.
  • Follows up with internal and external users, by email, phone, or webinar to gather more information to identify and solve technical problems related to the CHATS Salesforce application.
  • Documents, tracks, and monitors technical issues to ensure a timely resolution.
  • Submits and tracks user-reported issues in the incident management system(s)
  • Ensure the incident is assigned the correct priority, category, and impact
  • Validates user-reported bugs and system issues and identifies the root cause
  • Identify when issues are beyond the scope of basic support/Tier 1 and escalate and assign the incident to the appropriate internal or external technical team resource to be worked on and tracked to ensure the work is completed.
  • Ensures that the issues reported are documented with steps to reproduce expected outcomes, and include enough detail to easily reproduce, validate, and report to the administrator or developer to reach a resolution.
  • Communicates with end users to inform them of known system issues and issue resolution
  • Identifies issues/bugs that are duplicates of existing issues and creates a relationship with the parent ticket.
  • Assists with maintaining status on work items as things move through the bug/issue life cycle.
  • Documents issues and issue resolution to be used to update programmatic Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) and user guides.
  • Updates internal and external users on the status of their incident/bug requests.
  • Adhere to and inform the standard process for issue identification and resolution
  • Communicates to end users changes in the system, points of clarification, overall technical assistance, and updates to current processes based on issues reported and issues resolved
  • Participates in testing and validation activities.
Minimum Requirements:
  • Three years (minimum) demonstrated knowledge of and experience using: Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Suite
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Accurate, thorough, and detail-oriented
  • Efficient with time-sensitive projects
  • Preferred: Three years experience with using Salesforce Customer Resource Management (CRM) and Jira
  • Preferred: Functional understanding of the CH ATS application
  • Preferred: Current Salesforce Administrator Certification in progress

title: Systems Analyst III (AI & Automation)
description:
Job Title: Systems Analyst III (AI & Automation)
Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid)
Duration: 12+ Months

Key Responsibilities:
  • A Systems Analyst - Intern III will focus on engineering-related software services, including model ingestion, automated quantity extraction, plan conformance checks, and CI/CD automation. Leveraging PEPS ensures compliance with procurement regulations while enabling rapid onboarding of specialized talent.The Systems Analyst - Intern III understands business objectives and problems, identifies alternative solutions, performs studies and cost/benefit analysis of alternatives. Analyzes user requirements, procedures, and problems to automate processing or to improve existing computer system: Confers with personnel of organizational units involved to analyze current operational procedures, identify problems, and learn specific input and output requirements, such as forms of data input, how data is to be summarized, and formats for reports. Writes detailed description of user needs, program functions, and steps required to develop or modify computer program. Reviews computer system capabilities, specifications, and scheduling limitations to determine if requested program or program change is possible within existing system.
  • The Systems Analyst Intern will support TxDOT's Digital Delivery and AI initiatives by analyzing business objectives, identifying automation opportunities, and assisting in rapid development of solutions. This role combines traditional systems analysis with hands-on technical skills in AI, scripting, and automation to accelerate innovation. 1-3 years of experience in the field or in a related area. Has knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures within a particular field. Relies on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. Primary job functions do not typically require exercising independent judgment.
Education: Graduates with a Bachelor's degree (or higher) in one of the following fields:
  • Computer Science
  • Computer Information Systems
  • Data Science
  • Artificial Intelligence
Minimum Requirements:
  • Collaborate with business units to understand operational procedures, data requirements, and reporting needs (3 yrs exp preferred).
  • Document user requirements, workflows, and system specifications for new or modified applications (3 yrs exp preferred).
  • Perform feasibility studies and cost/benefit analysis for proposed solutions (3 yrs exp preferred).
  • Assist in developing scripts and prototypes to automate processes and integrate AI-driven features (3 yrs exp preferred).
  • Review system capabilities and constraints to ensure alignment with TxDOT standards (3 yrs exp preferred).
  • Support testing and validation of new solutions in a rapid development environment (3 yrs exp preferred).
  • AI/ML Fundamentals: Understanding of AI concepts and ability to apply pre-built models or APIs.
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python for data processing and automation tasks.
  • Scripting: Experience with Bash for system-level automation and deployment.
  • Rapid Development: Familiarity with agile methodologies and quick prototyping tools.
  • Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze business problems and propose technology-driven solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills for documenting requirements and collaborating with stakeholders.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and containerization (Docker).
  • Knowledge of data integration and API development.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Project Manager
Location: Harrisburg, PA (Hybrid – up to 2 days/month onsite)
Duration: 6+ Months
Type: Contract

The Client is seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional, multi-workstream program implementation initiatives across health and human services operations. This role is focused on program execution and stakeholder coordination, not IT system development.

The Senior Project Manager will drive end-to-end delivery of large-scale initiatives spanning policy implementation, operational readiness, and inter-agency coordination. The role requires strong governance discipline, executive communication, and the ability to translate policy objectives into actionable project plans and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage cross-program initiatives from planning through implementation and stabilization
  • Facilitate governance meetings, workgroups, and executive-level steering committees
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables
  • Build and manage core project artifacts including RACI matrices, RAID logs, action trackers, and status reports
  • Translate policy and program requirements into clear operational tasks and implementation steps
  • Identify risks and issues early; drive mitigation strategies and ensure accountability
  • Coordinate across Client program offices, state agencies, counties, providers, and federal partners (including CMS where applicable)
  • Support change management activities including stakeholder engagement, communications, and training readiness
  • Ensure accurate documentation of decisions, approvals, and implementation impacts
  • Provide leadership to junior project staff and ensure disciplined execution across workstreams

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience managing large, complex, multi-workstream programs
  • Strong experience in cross-functional coordination and stakeholder management
  • Expertise in project governance tools (workplans, RAID logs, RACI, action tracking, change control)
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to produce executive-ready documentation
  • Ability to work independently in ambiguous and evolving environments

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Medicaid, CMS, or broader health and human services programs
  • Familiarity with Section 1115 waivers or similar federal-state program implementations
  • Background in government operations, compliance, or regulatory-driven initiatives
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential
